title: Into the Barn

intro.speaker: hannah
intro.text: Brr! Snow on the hills. Tonight will be bitterly cold, so the sheep sleep in the barn.

intro.speaker: hannah
intro.text: There are three pens. Would you please share the sheep out, the same number in each, so they're not squashed?

steps.speaker: hannah
steps.prompt: Share the sheep so every pen has the same.

older.prompt: Share fourteen sheep among four pens. Any left over can sleep by the kitchen fire!

feedback.all_good: {n} sheep in each pen. Cosy and fair!

outro.speaker: hannah
outro.text: Snug as can be. Listen to them! That's a happy, sleepy sound.

journal_line: I helped Mrs. Hannah share her sheep into the barn pens for a snowy night.
